topicTitle: 1.9 Storage and Metabolic Role of Liver
explanation: When the pituitary gland releases growth hormone (GH), it stimulates the liver to produce and secrete insulin-like growth factors (IGFs), particularly IGF-1. These IGFs promote anabolic metabolism in the liver, including increased protein synthesis, glycogenesis, and lipid metabolism, which support overall body growth and development.
